categories.name: Textile & Clothing
categories.description: Retail, micro-stitching, and distribution of readymade garments, ethnic wear, and durable agrarian fabrics.
primary_activities: Procurement of wholesale fabric and finished garments
Micro-tailoring and customer alterations
Direct retail sales through weekly haats and taluka storefront
key_equipment: Industrial high-speed stitching machines
Fabric cutting table and heavy shears
Display racks, mannequins, and secure storage fixtures
Steam iron and garment finishing station
mandatory_licenses: Udyam MSME Registration Certificate
Local Panchayat / Municipal Trade & Establishment License
GST Registration (if annual turnover exceeds statutory threshold)
Shop and Establishment Act Registration
digital_enablement: Deploy BharatQR / UPI soundbox for friction-free micro-transactions.
Setup WhatsApp Business with digital product catalog and automated greeting.
Maintain digital khata (ledger) via Khatabook or Vyapar to track inventory turns.
first_90_days_milestones: Days 1-30: Complete Udyam registration, secure commercial premises near market transit, and open current account.
Days 31-60: Procure wholesale stock from regional textile hubs (e.g., Surat, Ahmedabad) and install display racks.
Days 61-90: Inaugural launch, distribute WhatsApp catalogs to local SHGs, and establish repeat weekly haat stalls.

categories.name: Dairy
categories.description: Small-scale milk collection, cold storage, livestock management, and value-added dairy product processing (ghee, paneer, curd).
primary_activities: Hygienic daily milk collection and fat-testing
Bulk milk chilling and local cold-chain preservation
Processing of high-margin items like Paneer, cultured Ghee, and fresh curd
Direct doorstep delivery to households and supply to town sweet marts
key_equipment: Bulk milk chiller / refrigeration unit (300-500L)
Digital milk fat analyzer and lactometer
Stainless steel milk cans (40L food-grade)
Cream separator and paneer pressing press
mandatory_licenses: Udyam MSME Registration Certificate
FSSAI Basic Food Business Registration / State License
Local Gram Panchayat NOC for livestock / dairy premises
Cattle insurance coverage linkage under National Livestock Mission
digital_enablement: Deploy automated SMS fat/SNF receipt notification for milk suppliers.
Enable UPI QR on delivery crates for daily customer subscription payments.
Use dairy management mobile app for tracking yield, fodder cost, and spoilage.
first_90_days_milestones: Days 1-30: Secure clean shed premises, water connection, and obtain FSSAI food registration.
Days 31-60: Procure certified milch cattle or contract 15+ local dairy farmers for daily collection.
Days 61-90: Install chiller, commence direct daily morning bottle supply, and initiate paneer production.

categories.name: Grocery
categories.description: Essential FMCG, grains, spices, packaged staples, and daily household provisions store for rural and semi-urban localities.
primary_activities: Wholesale procurement of food grains, pulses, oils, and packaged staples
Inventory categorization, micro-packaging, and retail shelving
Counter sales, phone order packing, and neighborhood home delivery
key_equipment: Commercial electronic weighing scales (countertop & heavy platform)
Heavy-duty steel slotted angle storage racks
Deep freezer / beverage glass-door cooler
POS barcode scanner & receipt thermal printer
mandatory_licenses: Udyam MSME Registration Certificate
FSSAI Registration for food grain & edible oil retailing
Trade License from local Gram Panchayat or Ward Municipal Council
Legal Metrology Verification Certificate for electronic weighing scales
digital_enablement: Deploy dual-language UPI soundbox at the billing counter.
Enable localized WhatsApp ordering with instant delivery within 30 minutes.
Implement digital barcode billing to control shrinkage and monitor stock expiry.
first_90_days_milestones: Days 1-30: Secure central storefront on main village/town road and complete trade licensing.
Days 31-60: Install heavy display racks, negotiate distributor trade margins, and stock fast-moving staples.
Days 61-90: Launch neighborhood delivery service, setup WhatsApp ordering, and initiate loyalty credit khata.

categories.name: Food Processing
categories.description: Micro-processing and packaging of agro-produce into value-added food items such as spices, flour, pickles, snacks, and baked goods.
primary_activities: Sorting, cleaning, and grading of raw agro-produce
Milling, pulverizing, baking, or pickling formulation
Nitrogen-flushed / moisture-barrier pouch packaging and labeling
Distribution to local retailers, tea stalls, and regional haats
key_equipment: Multi-purpose hammer mill / pulverizer machine
Continuous band sealer with nitrogen gas flushing
Commercial hot air dryer / oven
Stainless steel mixing tanks and food-grade storage drums
mandatory_licenses: Udyam MSME Registration Certificate
FSSAI Manufacturing / Processing License
State Pollution Control Board Consent to Operate (Green Category)
Water testing & food safety lab certification report
digital_enablement: Create digital brand identity with QR code on packaging for source verification.
List products on Open Network for Digital Commerce (ONDC) and regional B2B apps.
Maintain batch manufacturing records and expiry alerts digitally.
first_90_days_milestones: Days 1-30: Secure hygienic processing shed, water purification unit, and apply for FSSAI manufacturing license.
Days 31-60: Install pulverizing and packaging machinery, test trial production batches for shelf stability.
Days 61-90: Secure distributor agreements with 30+ rural retail outlets and launch branded packaging.

categories.name: Agriculture
categories.description: High-value horticulture, organic vegetable cultivation, precision micro-irrigation, and nursery seedling supply.
primary_activities: Soil preparation, organic enrichment, and raised bed layout
Drip irrigation installation and fertigation scheduling
Crop cultivation, pest scouting, and biocontrol management
Post-harvest sorting, grading, and direct mandi / farm-gate marketing
key_equipment: Solar pump / micro-irrigation drip manifold system
Power weeder / mini tiller for inter-row tilling
Knapsack battery-powered sprayers and shade net nursery structure
Perforated plastic harvesting crates and weighing scale
mandatory_licenses: PM-Kisan / Farmer ID Registration & Land 7/12 Records
Seed / Fertilizer Retail Dealer License (if selling inputs)
Organic Certification Scheme Enrollment (NPOP / PGS-India)
Groundwater extraction NOC from state irrigation authority (where applicable)
digital_enablement: Use satellite crop health & weather forecasting apps (e.g., Meghdoot, CropIn).
Link direct produce listing to e-NAM (National Agriculture Market) portal.
Direct farm-to-consumer WhatsApp community subscription boxes.
first_90_days_milestones: Days 1-30: Soil testing, field leveling, drip irrigation layout, and seed bed preparation.
Days 31-60: Sowing high-yield vegetable crops, trellising setup, and bio-fertilizer dosing.
Days 61-90: First harvest cycle, direct supply to peri-urban vegetable markets, and revenue realization.

categories.name: Handicrafts
categories.description: Traditional artisanal manufacturing of handloom fabrics, pottery, woodcraft, embroidery, and cultural home decor artifacts.
primary_activities: Sourcing authentic raw materials (clay, seasoned wood, natural dyed yarn)
Artisanal handcrafting, motif carving, and traditional finishing
Quality standardization, eco-friendly protective packaging, and tagging
Sales via craft exhibitions, heritage tourism retail, and online artisan marketplaces
key_equipment: Motorized potter's wheel / traditional handloom frame
Precision carving chisels, buffing machine, and sanding tools
Clay pug mill or natural dye extraction vat
Cushioned corrugated packaging unit and product photography light tent
mandatory_licenses: Udyam MSME Registration Certificate
Pehchan Artisan ID Card issued by Development Commissioner (Handicrafts)
Local Gram Panchayat artisan cottage permit
Handloom Mark / Silk Mark / Craftmark certification (for textile crafts)
digital_enablement: Setup Instagram and Facebook storefront showcasing artisan craft-making videos.
Onboard products on ONDC, Etsy, Amazon Karigar, and Indiahandmade portal.
Use UPI QR code for direct exhibition and tourism craft sales.
first_90_days_milestones: Days 1-30: Register for Pehchan artisan card, secure raw material bulk supply, and setup workshop.
Days 31-60: Standardize 10 core artisan product designs, create digital catalog and studio photos.
Days 61-90: Attend regional Saras Mela / craft haat, onboard to e-commerce, and establish regular output.

categories.name: Services
categories.description: Community services including two-wheeler/tractor repair, electrical servicing, grooming salon, and common service center (CSC) operations.
primary_activities: Diagnostic inspection, mechanical repair, or service provisioning
Spare parts inventory management and consumables stocking
Customer service scheduling, emergency doorstep assistance, and billing
key_equipment: Comprehensive pneumatic / hand toolkit and hydraulic lifting jack
Battery load tester, multimeter, and welding station
Air compressor with pressure regulator
All-in-one desktop computer with biometric scanner & laser printer (for CSC/services)
mandatory_licenses: Udyam MSME Registration Certificate
Local Panchayat / Municipal Trade License
National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) / ITI Trade Certificate
Electricity Department commercial connection sanction
digital_enablement: Setup Google Business Profile with location mapping for nearby customer discovery.
Deploy UPI soundbox and digital invoice generation on customer WhatsApp.
Implement automated maintenance reminder SMS for past service customers.
first_90_days_milestones: Days 1-30: Secure roadside workshop premises, complete trade registration, and power connection.
Days 31-60: Install core diagnostic tools, air compressor, and establish spare parts vendor credit.
Days 61-90: Distribute local pamphlets, setup Google Maps profile, and achieve steady daily service footfall.
